notes.title: Simplied battle! Less softlocks!
notes.content:
Whew!

Been a while since we had an update like this. Thanks to everyone who let me know about bugs! Keep them coming!

In this update:
[list]
[*] Removed TP, now your only stats are HP and AP (a combined MP and TP)
[*] Added more clues for trading game
[*] Leveling up is now based on progress and on XP
[*] Made staring contest easier
[*] Added new items
[*] Fixed softlocks possible in block puzzle and castle graveyard
[*] Revised dialogue
[*] Cleaned up some sprites
[*] Cleaned up tile z-indexing
[*] Removed some lines from REM bit
[*] Same amount of vore
[/list]

Next up, eventually
[list]
[*] Grind dungeon
[*] Remastered music
[*] Revised art
[/list]

notes.title: Core update and removed anti-malware false positive
notes.content:
This update will get the game to the newest RPGMaker Version.

Also Win 11 and some Macs have been deleting a library because it was flagged as dangerous. This was used for save files, so writing to disk probably flagged it. I've removed it. The save screen is now the out of box RPGmaker.

Thanks!

notes.title: Staring Contest Help and More Gravestones
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qrhcksd.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Updated the Inn conversation triggers, hopefully fixing  the problem with initiating talk when first in town.
[*] Added a Hint Ghost to allow for bypassing the staring contest, just enable the assistance under options and you'll be given a ghost that will let you skip the minigame.
[*] Graves have been updated with items from friends of the game Haunted Husband ([url=twitch.tv/HauntedHusband]twitch.tv/HauntedHusband[/url]),  Matty Francis ([url=https://linktr.ee/Mattyfrances]https://linktr.ee/Mattyfrances[/url]), and 'Rome Fitz ([url=https://open.spotify.com/show/2MVFTUk6i5P3y4w6VeOTjY]https://open.spotify.com/show/2MVFTUk6i5P3y4w6VeOTjY[/url]) 
[*] Boss battle balance improvements
[*] Jokes and formatting tuned.
[/list]

Want to be a friend of the game and get a gravestone in a future update? Sure why not. Finish the game and DM and me and I'll put stuff in.

notes.title: Achievement Patch + Fixes
notes.content:
Patch to fix issues with the following:

[list]
[*] Cookies Achievement was not triggering on one branch of the conversation that triggers it
[*] Stare achievement was not triggering on one branch of conversation that triggers it
[*] Final boss achievement was not triggering after battle
[*] Hint mode was not toggling correctly
[*] Novel mode was not being applied on new party members
[*] Small interaction fixes (doors, chests)
[/list]

Thank you and please feel free to message me if you bump into anything else. I'm the only dev but I'll do my best to iron anything you find out.
